modmenu.descriptionTranslation.borderles: Lets ye sail the blocky seas o' Minecraft in a borderless fullscreen window. Arrr!
borderlessmc.options.fullscreenType.tool: Chooses which fullscreen riggin' be hoisted when §oFullscreen§r be set to §oON§r in §oVideo Settings§r. Arrr!
borderlessmc.options.borderlessFullscree: Chooses which fullscreen riggin' be hoisted when §oFullscreen§r be set to §oBorderless§r in §oVideo Settings§r.
borderlessmc.options.useDelayedFullscree:
Chooses whether to hold yer horses afore hoistin' fullscreen until Minecraft be loaded from bow to stern.

Turnin' this on may make startup sail smoother and mend rare curses from scurvy drivers that refuse to let certain windows enter fullscreen straightaway at a resolution unlike the usual one.
borderlessmc.options.useScaledFramebuffe:
Chooses whether to use a full-resolution framebuffer on seas where screen coordinates can be scaled against pixel coordinates, such as §omacOS§r and §oWayland (Linux)§r.

Turnin' this off may grant yer vessel a mighty burst o' speed, though the picture may look a wee bit rougher.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocus: Drop Anchor When Focus Be Lost
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocus.to: Chooses whether the game should drop anchor and pause itself whenever its window loses focus.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocusDur: Drop Anchor When Focus Be Lost (Crew)
When §oDrop Anchor When Focus Be Lost§r be enabled, chooses whether the same order applies while sailin' with a crew, where the game cannot truly drop anchor.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:w:
A windowed fullscreen rig whose speed and handling change with the waters ye sail.

On §lWindows§r, this generally be the finest course: all the treasure of borderless fullscreen with little to no toll on speed or latency. Yet some captains may spy cursed blinkin' whenever the game window gains or loses focus.

On §lother platforms§r, these waters may turn rough, causin' poor performance or usability troubles such as yer dock remainin' visible or floatin' atop the game.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:d:
Minecraft's default exclusive fullscreen riggin'.

Gives ye mighty performance with barely a whisper o' latency, but every time the window loses focus the game scurries below deck and minimizes.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:h:
Minecraft's default non-exclusive fullscreen riggin'.

These be the middle waters betwixt exclusive and borderless fullscreen, meant chiefly for captains who need not a truly borderless voyage but still want overlays, IME, or similar sorcery.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.linux:borde:
The default borderless fullscreen riggin' fer Linux.

Sails fast with barely any latency and, as far as the lookout can spy, carries no known curses.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.macos:borde:
The default borderless fullscreen riggin' fer macOS.

Sails respectably, though with a touch more latency than exclusive fullscreen because the OS lashes V-Sync onto every windowed vessel.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.windows:win:
The true windowed fullscreen riggin' fer Windows.

Unlike §ominecraft:windowed§r, this vessel suffers none o' the cursed blinkin', though it also misses that mode's performance treasure.

Its latency be higher than exclusive fullscreen because the OS lashes V-Sync onto windowed vessels. Windows may also toss frames overboard whilst busy with background chores it reckons more important.
borderlessmc.config.title: BorderlessMC
